config.title: Build typed localStorage wrapper

intro.title: Build typed localStorage wrapper
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a typed wrapper for the browser's localStorage API using TypeScript. You'll learn how to create a reusable utility that ensures data stored and retrieved is type-safe, preventing common runtime errors. The core concept involves using TypeScript generics to define flexible functions that work with various data types while maintaining strict type checks. You'll implement key functions like getItem, setItem, and removeItem, applying TypeScript interfaces and type annotations. This project will help you understand how to enhance JavaScript APIs with TypeScript's static typing for better code reliability and developer experience.
intro.usecase: A typed localStorage wrapper is essential in real-world applications like user dashboards and settings panels, where you need to persist user preferences, theme choices, or filter states across sessions. For example, in a project management dashboard, it ensures that a user's column sort order or collapsed panel state is reliably saved and retrieved with full type safety. This pattern prevents common bugs in forms or complex UIs by guaranteeing that stored data matches the expected TypeScript interfaces, making the code more maintainable and less error-prone.

objectives: Construct a TypeScript class to encapsulate localStorage operations
Implement generic type parameters to ensure type-safe data storage and retrieval
Apply TypeScript interfaces to define the structure of stored data
Configure error handling for JSON parsing and serialization failures
Initialize a wrapper instance with default values and validation logic
Manipulate localStorage data through typed getter and setter methods
Integrate the wrapper into a TypeScript project to replace direct localStorage usage

steps.title: Create TypeScript interface for localStorage wrapper
steps.instruction: Create a TypeScript interface named LocalStorageWrapper with getItem and setItem method signatures.
steps.hint: Define an interface with two methods: getItem that takes a string key and returns a string or null, and setItem that takes a string key and a string value and returns void.
steps.expectedOutcome: You'll have a TypeScript interface that defines the shape of a localStorage wrapper with typed method signatures.
successCriteria: The LocalStorageWrapper interface is defined with getItem and setItem method signatures.
steps.feedbackCorrect: Nice! Proceed to the next step.
steps.feedbackPartial: You're on the right track, but make sure both getItem and setItem methods are defined with proper TypeScript signatures.
steps.feedbackWrong: Create an interface named LocalStorageWrapper with two methods: getItem(key: string): string | null and setItem(key: string, value: string): void.

steps.title: Implement the getItem method with type parameter
steps.instruction: Create a function named getItem that accepts a key string parameter and returns a value of generic type T. The function should parse the stored JSON string and return the typed value.
steps.hint: Define a generic function with type parameter T. Use localStorage.getItem to retrieve the string, then parse it with JSON.parse.

// Implement getItem method here
steps.expectedOutcome: A typed getItem function that can retrieve and parse stored values with proper TypeScript type safety.
successCriteria: Function getItem is defined with generic type parameter T, accepts a key string, retrieves from localStorage, parses JSON, and returns typed value.
steps.feedbackCorrect: Nice! Proceed to the next step.
steps.feedbackPartial: You're on the right track. Make sure your function uses a generic type parameter T and properly parses the JSON string from localStorage.
steps.feedbackWrong: The getItem method isn't implemented correctly. It should be a generic function that retrieves and parses localStorage values.

steps.title: Add error handling to getItem method
steps.instruction: Wrap the existing getItem method implementation in a try-catch block to handle JSON parsing errors and missing items, returning null for any errors.
steps.hint: Add try { ... } catch { ... } around your existing code. In the catch block, return null.
steps.expectedOutcome: The getItem method will now safely handle parsing errors and missing items by returning null instead of throwing exceptions.
successCriteria: The getItem method contains a try-catch block that catches errors and returns null.
steps.feedbackCorrect: Nice! Proceed to the next step.
steps.feedbackPartial: You're on the right track, but make sure the try-catch block wraps the entire method implementation and returns null in the catch block.
steps.feedbackWrong: The getItem method should include a try-catch block that returns null for any errors. Check that it wraps the existing parsing logic.

steps.title: Implement the setItem method with type parameter
steps.instruction: Add a setItem method to the LocalStorageWrapper interface and implement it in the localStorageWrapper object. The method should take a key string and a value of generic type T.
steps.hint: Remember to update the interface first, then add the method implementation. Use localStorage.setItem and JSON.stringify.
steps.expectedOutcome: The LocalStorageWrapper interface now includes a setItem method signature, and localStorageWrapper has a corresponding implementation that stores typed values.
successCriteria: The interface has a setItem<T>(key: string, value: T): void method, and the object implements setItem with localStorage.setItem and JSON.stringify.
steps.feedbackCorrect: Nice! Proceed to the next step.
steps.feedbackPartial: You've added a setItem method, but check that it uses the generic type T and properly stores the value with JSON.stringify.
steps.feedbackWrong: The setItem method is missing or incorrect. Ensure it's added to both the interface and the object implementation.

steps.title: Add JSON serialization to setItem method
steps.instruction: Inside the setItem method of localStorageWrapper, use JSON.stringify to convert the value parameter to a JSON string before storing it in localStorage.
steps.hint: Call localStorage.setItem with the key and the stringified value.
steps.expectedOutcome: The setItem method will properly serialize typed values to JSON strings for storage in localStorage.
successCriteria: The setItem method uses JSON.stringify to convert the value parameter before calling localStorage.setItem.
steps.feedbackCorrect: Nice! Proceed to the next step.
steps.feedbackPartial: You're on the right track. Make sure to use JSON.stringify on the value parameter before passing it to localStorage.setItem.
steps.feedbackWrong: The setItem method should convert the value to a JSON string using JSON.stringify before storing it in localStorage.

steps.title: Create removeItem and clear methods
steps.instruction: Inside the localStorageWrapper object, implement the removeItem method that takes a key string and removes it from localStorage, and the clear method that clears all localStorage.
steps.hint: The removeItem method should call localStorage.removeItem(key). The clear method should call localStorage.clear().
steps.expectedOutcome: The localStorageWrapper object will have removeItem and clear methods that interact with localStorage.
successCriteria: The localStorageWrapper object contains a removeItem method that takes a key string and calls localStorage.removeItem, and a clear method that calls localStorage.clear.
steps.feedbackCorrect: Nice! Proceed to the next step.
steps.feedbackPartial: You're on the right track, but make sure both methods are implemented correctly inside the localStorageWrapper object.
steps.feedbackWrong: The removeItem and clear methods are missing or incorrectly implemented. Check the hint and analogous example.

steps.instruction: Create a class named TypedLocalStorage that implements the LocalStorageWrapper interface.
steps.hint: Use the class keyword followed by the class name, then implements LocalStorageWrapper, and include the method signatures from the interface.
steps.expectedOutcome: A class TypedLocalStorage is defined that implements the LocalStorageWrapper interface.
successCriteria: The TypedLocalStorage class is created with the correct name and implements the LocalStorageWrapper interface.
steps.feedbackCorrect: Nice! Proceed to the next step.

steps.feedbackWrong: The TypedLocalStorage class is not properly defined or doesn't implement the LocalStorageWrapper interface. Check the class syntax and the implements keyword.
